propositions: Blocking link edges written before comparability became structural remain corrupt on disk because LINK events are durable and not re-resolved on read, distorting ready/next-batch scheduling logic

A store-wide scan must detect three categories of invalid edges (ancestor-blocking when an endpoint is an ancestor of the other, mis-escalated when the resolver returns a different pair, unreadable when an endpoint cannot be reduced) by comparing recorded links against the current resolver

Repair must write the replacement link before removing the stale edge so an interruption leaves a superset rather than losing a dependency, and must refuse pairs where relation-scoped unlink is ambiguous

The doctor command must refuse to run during an active reconciler pass, must not acquire a persistent store lock across multiple writes, and must write a pre-doctor-repair tag at the pre-run OID as a rollback anchor
Read-only scans must not reconverge the store, while repair passes must reconverge to reflect corrected graph state
Residual unrepairable edges with closed ticket endpoints cannot affect scheduling and remain inert historical records
